arxiv-1909-01795.title: Stochastic Submodular Probing with State-Dependent Costs
arxiv-1909-01795.creator: Shaojie Tang
arxiv-1909-01795.description: Abstract In this paper, we study a new stochastic submodular maximization problem with state-dependent costs and rejections. The input of our problem is a budget constraint B B , and a set of items whose states (i.e., the marginal contribution and the cost of an item) are drawn from a known probability distribution.

arxiv-2301-01064.title: PIE-QG: Paraphrased Information Extraction for Unsupervised Question Generation from Small Corpora
arxiv-2301-01064.creator: Dinesh Nagumothu, Bahadorreza Ofoghi, Guangyan Huang, Peter W. Eklund
arxiv-2301-01064.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Dinesh Nagumothu, Bahadorreza Ofoghi, Guangyan Huang, Peter W. Eklund. Supervised Question Answering systems (QA systems) rely on domain-specific human-labeled data for training. Unsupervised QA systems generate their own question-answer training pairs, typically using secondary knowledge sources to achieve this outcome. Our approach (called PIE-QG) uses Open Information Extraction (OpenIE) to generate synthetic training questions from paraphrased passages and uses the question-answer pairs as training data for a language model for a state-of-the-art QA system based on BERT.

arxiv-2302-11017.title: Enhancing Energy System Models Using Better Load Forecasts
arxiv-2302-11017.creator: Thomas Möbius, Mira Watermeyer, Oliver Grothe, Felix Müsgens
arxiv-2302-11017.description: Abstract Energy system models require a large amount of technical and economic data, the quality of which significantly influences the reliability of the results. Some of the variables on the important data source ENTSO-E transparency platform, such as transmission system operators’ day-ahead load forecasts, are known to be biased.

arxiv-2310-12413.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Zengle Zhang 1 and Jiazu Zhou 2,3,∗∗. arxiv-2411-01482.title: A (Hilbert) geometric algorithm for approximating the halfspace depth of a point in a convex body
arxiv-2411-01482.creator: Purvi Gupta, Anant Narayanan
arxiv-2411-01482.description: Abstract . Halfspace (or Tukey) depth is a fundamental and robust measure of centrality of data points in multivariate datasets. Computing the depth of a point with respect to the uniform distribution on an open convex body in ℝ d \mathbb{R}^{d} is a natural algorithmic problem.

arxiv-2504-05812.title: Right Question is Already Half the Answer: Fully Unsupervised LLM Reasoning Incentivization
arxiv-2504-05812.creator: Qingyang Zhang, Haitao Wu, Changqing Zhang, Peilin Zhao, Yatao Bian
arxiv-2504-05812.description: Abstract Existing methods to enhance the reasoning capability of large language models predominantly rely on supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by reinforcement learning (RL) on reasoning-specific data. These approaches critically depend on external supervisions–such as labeled reasoning traces, verified golden answers, or pre-trained reward models.

arxiv-2505-06207.title: Leveraging Multi-Task Learning for Multi-Label Power System Security Assessment
arxiv-2505-06207.creator: M. E. Za’ter, A. Sajadi, B. M. Hodge
arxiv-2505-06207.description: Abstract This paper introduces a novel approach to the power system security assessment using Multi-Task Learning (MTL), and reformulating the problem as a multi-label classification task. The proposed MTL framework simultaneously assesses static, voltage, transient, and small-signal stability, improving both accuracy and interpretability with respect to the most state of the art machine learning methods.

arxiv-2508-13459.title: Multi-Robot Navigation in Social Mini-Games: Definitions, Taxonomy, and Algorithms
arxiv-2508-13459.creator: Rohan Chandra, Shubham Singh, Abhishek Jha, Dannon Andrade, Hriday Sainathuni, Katia Sycara https://socialminigames.github.io/
arxiv-2508-13459.description: Abstract The “Last Mile Challenge” has long been considered an important, yet unsolved, challenge for autonomous vehicles, public service robots, and delivery robots. A central issue in this challenge is the ability of robots to navigate constrained and cluttered environments that have high agency (e.g., doorways, hallways, corridor intersections), often while competing for space with other robots and humans.

arxiv-2602-10723.title: Quantum Cosmology in f ⁡ ( R , T ) f(R,T) Theory with Schutz’s Perfect Fluid
arxiv-2602-10723.creator: Serkan Doruk Hazinedar, Yaghoub Heydarzade, and Shahram Jalalzadeh
arxiv-2602-10723.description: Abstract The f ⁡ ( R , T ) f(R,T) theory of gravity extends general relativity (GR) by allowing the gravitational Lagrangian to depend on both the Ricci scalar R R and the trace of the energy-momentum tensor T T .

arxiv-2602-17371.title: Dynamical Modelling of Galactic Kinematics using Neural Networks
arxiv-2602-17371.creator: David A. Simon and Michele Cappellari and Shude Mao and Jiani Chu and Dandan Xu
arxiv-2602-17371.description: Abstract The advent of integral field data has revolutionised the study of galaxy evolution. A key component of this is dynamical modelling methods which have allowed for crucial insights to be made from kinematic data. Despite this importance, most dynamical models make a number of key assumptions which do not hold for real galaxies.

pmc-11345211.title: Association between multiple jobs and physical and psychological symptoms among the Korean working population
pmc-11345211.creator: Seok-Yoon Son, Jin-Young Min, Seung-Woo Ryoo, Baek-Yong Choi, Kyoung-Bok Min
pmc-11345211.description: BackgroundThe prevalence of multiple job-holding (MJH) is expected to show an upward trend among Korean workers, yet its potential impact on workers’ health remains poorly discussed. This study aimed to explore the association between MJH and experience of physical and psychological symptoms in various aspects among active Korean workers and to identify its differences depending on workers’ gender.

pmc-11473574.title: Elevated fibrinogen-albumin ratio is an adverse prognostic factor for patients with primarily resected gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma
pmc-11473574.creator: Gerd Jomrich, Winny Yan, Dagmar Kollmann, Ivan Kristo, Daniel Winkler, Hannah Puhr, Aysegül lhan-Mutlu, Marlene Hollenstein, Reza Asari, Sebastian F Schoppmann
pmc-11473574.description: PurposeSerum fibrinogen and albumin play important roles in systemic inflammation and are implicated in tumor progression. The fibrinogen-to-albumin ratio (FAR) has shown a prognostic impact in several malignancies. This study aims to assess the prognostic value of the pretherapeutic FAR in patients with adenocarcinoma of the gastroesophageal junction (AEG) who underwent upfront resection.

pmc-11631505.title: HLA-EpiCheck: novel approach for HLA B-cell epitope prediction using 3D-surface patch descriptors derived from molecular dynamic simulations
pmc-11631505.creator: Diego Amaya-Ramirez, Magali Devriese, Romain Lhotte, Cédric Usureau, Malika Smaïl-Tabbone, Jean-Luc Taupin, Marie-Dominique Devignes, Franca Fraternali
pmc-11631505.description: MotivationThe human leukocyte antigen (HLA) system is the main cause of organ transplant loss through the recognition of HLAs present on the graft by donor-specific antibodies raised by the recipient. It is therefore of key importance to identify all potentially immunogenic B-cell epitopes on HLAs in order to refine organ allocation.

pmc-12472260.description: Background and objectives: The objective of this study was to test the effects of objectively measured screen time using wearable cameras, along with dietary intake and physical activity level (and their interaction), on obesity among Chinese school-aged children. Methods: This study was conducted among 52 fourth-grade children (age: 9.76 ± 0.

pmc-12523500.title: EMDR treatment in patients with personality disorders. Should we fear symptom exacerbation?
pmc-12523500.creator: Laurian Hafkemeijer, Ad de Jongh, Annemieke Starrenburg, Trynke Hoekstra, Karin Slotema
pmc-12523500.description: Background: Clinicians are often hesitant to use trauma-focused therapy for patients with personality disorders (PDs) because of concerns that the pathology may worsen.Objective: Exploring trajectories of change and individual exacerbations in psychological distress and suicidal thoughts in patients with a PD without comorbid posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD) during EMDR therapy or waiting time.

pmc-12569784.title: Proteomic analyses of the regulatory mechanisms underlying Pochonia chlamydosporia infection in Parascaris equorum eggs
pmc-12569784.creator: Yuan Ma, Jinbao Lv, Luyao Hao, Zhengyi Li, Chengyu Ma, Rui Wang, Lili Jiang, Zhaobin Fan
pmc-12569784.description: BackgroundPochonia chlamydosporia is an important egg-parasitic fungus with potential applications in the biological control of parasitic pests. However, the protein-response mechanisms during P. chlamydosporia infection of nematode eggs remain unclear. In this study, we employed four-dimensional data-independent acquisition (4D-DIA) proteomic sequencing to analyze the changes in the mycelial proteome of P. chlamydosporia at different infection stages.

pmc-12609941.title: Population Dynamics and Potential Distribution of the Four Endangered Mangrove Species in Leizhou Peninsula China
pmc-12609941.creator: Jianjian Huang, Bing Yang, Jie Chen, Suqing Liu, Xueying Wen, Yingchun Zhu, Kangyi Deng, Hui Zhu, Yuzhong Zheng, Qinghan Wu, Yongqin Zheng, Jean Wan Hong Yong, Fengnian Wu, Xiaolong Lan
pmc-12609941.description: Background: Mangrove plants are a core component of coastal ecosystems, directly influencing biodiversity and shoreline stability. However, in recent years, due to the combined pressures of human activities and climate change, nearly half of the mangrove species in China are endangered and require urgent conservation measures.

pmc-12623512.title: Optimization of the radiosynthesis of the PSMA-targeting drugs [177Lu]Lu-P17-087 and [177Lu]Lu-P17-088 on the MiniLu™ automated module
pmc-12623512.creator: David Alexoff, Karl Ploessl, Ruiyue Zhao, Linlin Li, Dohyun Kim, Lin Zhu, Hank Kung
pmc-12623512.description: BackgroundThere is a renewed interest in radioligand therapy for cancer treatment since the approval of Lu-177 vipivotide tetraxetan (PSMA-617) by regulators in Europe and the United States for metastatic castrate resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC) patients. Recent expansion of indications for vipivotide tetraxetan in mCRPC by the FDA promises to increase demand for this class of radioligand therapy.

pmc-12687745.description: Adolescent social isolation (aSI) has been demonstrated to increase anxiety-like behavior and ethanol consumption. The ventral pallidum (VP), a basal ganglia structure that receives dopaminergic projections from the VTA, contributes to reward and aversion processing, and is highly responsive to psychosocial stressors.

pmc-12797523.title: The correlation between serum ECM1 and cardiac fibrosis in heart failure patients
pmc-12797523.creator: Yanqian Xu, Zhongyuan Han, Qi Lu
pmc-12797523.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundChronic heart failure (HF) is characterized by progressive myocardial injury and remodeling. Extracellular matrix protein 1 (ECM1) and low-density lipoprotein receptor-related protein 1 (LRP1) have been implicated in fibrosis; however, their clinical significance in HF remains unclear.

pmc-12979437.title: Computational hermeneutics: evaluating generative AI as a cultural technology
pmc-12979437.creator: Cody Kommers, Ruth Ahnert, Maria Antoniak, Emmanouil Benetos, Steve Benford, Mercedes Bunz, Baptiste Caramiaux, Shauna Concannon, Martin Disley, James Dobson, Yali Du, Edgar Duéñez-Guzmán, Kerry Francksen, Evelyn Gius, Jonathan W. Y. Gray, Ryan Heuser, Sarah Immel, Richard Jean So, Sang Leigh, Dalak
pmc-12979437.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Generative AI (GenAI) systems are increasingly recognized as cultural technologies, yet current evaluation frameworks often treat culture as a variable to be measured rather than fundamental to the system's operation. Drawing on hermeneutic theory from the humanities, we argue that GenAI systems function as "context machines" that must inherently address three interpretive challenges: situatedness (meaning only emerges in context), plurality (multiple valid interpretations coexist), and ambiguity (interpretations naturally conflict).

pmc-13208002.title: Mutation Spectrum of ADAMTS13 Gene in Patients with Upshaw–Schulman Syndrome (USS) in Russia
pmc-13208002.creator: Julia Poznyakova, Olesya Pshenichnikova, Elizaveta Klebanova, Gennadiy Galstyan, Vadim Surin
pmc-13208002.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Upshaw–Schulman syndrome (USS) is a rare inherited autosomal recessive thrombotic microangiopathy affecting less than 1/1,000,000 individuals. It is a congenital form of thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura (TTP) caused by ADAMTS13 protease deficiency because of mutations in the ADAMTS13 gene. USS is characterized by the formation of platelet thrombi in the microcirculation, accompanied by hemolytic anemia, thrombocytopenia, and clinical and laboratory signs of renal and neurological failure. The aim of this study was to describe the ADAMTS13 gene mutation spectrum in the Russian population.

pmc-13359850.title: Emerging Multimodal Point-of-Care Diagnostic Strategies for Rapid Detection and Management of Respiratory Viruses: A State-of-the-Art Review
pmc-13359850.creator: Helal F. Hetta, Abdul Haseeb, Salwa Qasim Bukhari, Zinab Alatawi, Ahmad J. Mahrous, Mahmoud E. Elrggal, Mohammad Al Masri, Ahmed A. Kotb
pmc-13359850.description: The co-circulation of respiratory viruses, including SARS-CoV-2, influenza A/B, and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), represents a significant global health challenge that requires rapid, accurate, and differential diagnosis to support infection control and appropriate clinical decision-making. This narrative review summarizes emerging multimodal point-of-care testing (POCT) strategies for the detection and management of these respiratory viruses.

pmc-13457985.title: Intra‐Individual Variability in Children's Self‐Regulation in Kindergarten Classrooms: An Observational Study
pmc-13457985.creator: Nora Tilda Kunz, Niamh Oeri
pmc-13457985.description: Children's ability to self‐regulate varies across days and contextual demands. However, the predominant approach in developmental science is to assess self‐regulation at a single timepoint in one context, limiting our understanding of how and why children's self‐regulation skills vary intra‐ and inter‐individually.

pmc-13461676.title: Platelet Transfusion Thresholds and Associated Outcomes in Adult ICU Patients with Thrombocytopenia: A Retrospective Observational Study
pmc-13461676.creator: Nipun Yallawar
pmc-13461676.description: IntroductionPlatelet transfusion practices in critically ill adults vary widely, and real-world triggers often deviate from guideline-suggested thresholds.1,2 Data from Indian intensive care units on indications, pre-transfusion platelet counts, and their relationship with bleeding and mortality are limited.ObjectivesTo describe platelet transfusion triggers and indications in critically ill adults and to explore associations between transfusion characteristics, bleeding complications, and hospital mortality.

uslaw-usc-t25-s1831.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t25-s1831.description: United States Code, Title 25 (Indians); Chapter 20 (Tribally Controlled Colleges And Universities Assistance); Subchapter II (Tribally Controlled College Or University Endowment Program). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. It is the purpose of this subchapter to provide grants for the encouragement of endowment funds for the operation and improvement of tribally controlled colleges or universities.
